V4.argument: pack clamps every length to min(L, max_tokens) before use, so a document alone never exceeds max_tokens; a document is only appended to a non-empty batch when tot + L <= max_tokens, otherwise the batch is flushed first. By induction every batch total, computed with clamped lengths, stays <= max_tokens for all inputs in scope.

V5.argument: shuffle_stream stores each incoming item in the buffer (either appended while the buffer is below max(1, buffer_size), or written into slot j immediately after the previous occupant of slot j is emitted). Every item is emitted exactly once: either when evicted from its slot or in the final drain that pops the buffer until empty. Hence the output is a multiset permutation of the input for every buffer_size >= 1.
